_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Demonstrates Co-wavelength-channel integration of Ultra-low frequency DAS (0.1 Hz) and High-Capacity Comm (241.85 Tb/s) over a 7-Core Fiber using Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing (DSM).

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Setup showing shared wavelength channel for Sensing (Chirped Pulse) and Comm (DSM) over 7-Core Fiber. Fig 2: Q-factor, BER, and Strain Sensing results (0.1 Hz vibration).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Cabled Fiber ISAC (SDM). Sensing: DAS (Rayleigh Backscatter). Comm: 36 GBaud DP-16QAM DSM. Method: Frequency Division Multiplexing of Sensing and Comm signals within the *same* wavelength channel (Insertion into Protection Interval).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 241.85 Tb/s (Aggregate over 7 cores). Sensing: 3.89 nε/√Hz sensitivity @ 0.1 Hz. 20m resolution. Fiber: 38 km MCF.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Addresses capacity crunch using SDM (7-core fiber) and spectral efficiency by co-integrating sensing/comm in same wavelength. Focuses on ultra-low frequency sensing for ocean monitoring.

bibliographic.title: Co-wavelength-channel Integration of Ultra-lowfrequency Distributed Acoustic Sensing and High-Capacity Communication
bibliographic.authors: Long Gu, Meng Xiang, Zebing Zhang, Chaocheng Liu, Pengbai Xu, Wei Sun, Jun Yang, Songnian Fu, Yuncai Wang, Yuwen Qin

application.scenario_description: Submarine ocean monitoring (detecting ultra-low frequency seismic/ocean waves 0.1-10 Hz) using multicore fiber infrastructure.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Co-wavelength integration of Ultra-low frequency DAS and High-Capacity Comm over 7-Core Fiber using DSM with sensing pulse in protection interval.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Spectral efficiency loss in separate-core SDM sensing and difficulty of low-frequency DAS <10Hz in existing ISAC systems.

transmitter.notes: 36 GBaud DP-16QAM Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing (DSM). Sensing Pulse inserted in Protection Interval.

receiver.notes: Coherent Receiver for Comm. Direct Detection (PD) for Sensing after filtering.

integration.notes: Sensing and Comm share the same wavelength channel (FDM in digital domain via DSM). Multi-core fiber used for capacity.

waveform.notes: Chirped pulse (500 MHz) frequency multiplexed into the DSM signal gap.

comm_metrics.notes: Aggregate Capacity 241.85 Tb/s (96 WDM channels x 7 Cores). Net capacity 201.5 Tb/s.

sensing_metrics.notes: Sensitivity: 3.89 nε/√Hz @ 0.1 Hz. Capable of detecting 0.1 Hz ultra-low frequency vibrations.

tradeoff.notes: Q-factor penalty observed when integrating DAS, decreases with larger Protection Interval.
